component.name: DaVinci Resolve Toolkit
component.summary: Fix AAC audio and streamline DaVinci Resolve on Linux from the system tray

description.p: DaVinci Resolve Toolkit adds opt-in experimental native AAC import and AAC-LC export to supported Resolve Studio builds on Linux. A system tray and settings window manage activation, rollback, launch actions and extras.
Legacy conversion workflows remain available for compatibility: AAC audio is converted to PCM copies while video and original files stay untouched.

ul.li: Native AAC import and AAC-LC export with paired activation and removal
Automatic AAC remuxing for imports and the media pool
Remux the current clip or every media pool clip on demand from Resolve's Scripts menu
Restore original sources to undo remuxing for a project at any time
Export watcher that rewrites render audio to web-friendly AAC
System tray with launch actions, toggles, cache settings, and logs
Native KDE file dialogs and a Fusion font fix
Modern welcome and settings window for first-run setup

description.p: Not affiliated with or endorsed by Blackmagic Design. DaVinci Resolve is a trademark of Blackmagic Design.

description.p: Improves native dialogs and manual Resolve ZIP updates.

ul.li: Native Relink and direct Deliver pickers on the verified Studio 21.1.1 Native AAC build
Background executable verification avoids the first Relink click delay
Render-location confirmations respect muted notifications
Studio 21.1.1 import-patch compatibility and verified installer reuse
Clear final update status and compact settings windows

description.p: Fixes permission errors when removing Native AAC or updating Resolve.

ul.li: Privileged patch operations no longer create root-owned Python caches
Existing protected patch caches are replaced without blocking the update

description.p: Update the toolkit directly from Welcome or the tray menu.

ul.li: Background checks show the update button only when an update is available
RPM and archive updates preserve settings, cache and the Resolve AAC patch
Toolkit restarts after updating; Welcome uses a shorter, neutral reminder

description.p: Adds opt-in experimental native AAC support for Resolve Studio 21.

ul.li: Direct AAC import and AAC-LC export with paired installation and removal
Legacy conversion workflows remain available for compatibility
Resolve ZIP updates manage existing native patches with verification
Single-instance tray, activation progress and a collapsible Welcome guide

description.p: Makes AAC imports and native Deliver browsing more responsive and reliable.

ul.li: Prioritizes newly imported clips while scanning large projects incrementally
Detects Resolve restarts by process generation and restores stopped watchers
Hardens the native Deliver Browse hand-off and validates its dependencies
Adds timestamped MediaPool scan diagnostics

description.p: Fixes excessive memory growth in the MediaPool watcher.

ul.li: Avoids a leaking unkeyed property call in Resolve's Linux scripting API
Adds a 256 MiB watcher recycle guard for future native leaks
Restarts unexpectedly exited watchers without overriding a manual stop

description.p: Improves MediaPool reliability and native dialog handling.

ul.li: Retries temporary Resolve API failures without remuxing files again
Keeps multi-bin relinking in Resolve's own dialog
Remembers Deliver folders containing non-ASCII characters
Repairs stale tray autostart paths after package installation

description.p: Installs on stock Fedora without RPM Fusion.
The package is now named davinci-resolve-toolkit to match the app.
Now available from Fedora Copr and Discover, with a trademark notice.
This release rebrands to DaVinci Resolve Toolkit and makes remuxing reversible.

ul.li: Restore original sources to undo AAC remuxing for a project
Remux the current clip or the whole media pool on demand from Resolve's Scripts menu
The media pool watcher now stops together with Resolve and the tray
